pr-review-facts.title: Move rate-limit identity from IP to token
pr-review-facts.author: aria
pr-review-facts.head: aria/token-buckets
pr-review-facts.description:
Moves authenticated requests from shared per-IP buckets to per-token buckets. Requests without a token continue to use their remote address. Adds persistent token buckets and passes the request into the limiter.

Test plan: unit coverage for key selection and token isolation, plus a migration dry run.
